text:
sam-ops: Heads up: Aurora Supply says 8 H100s for EU top-up cleared customs but depot is refusing them — missing return labels on DOA batch. AWB: 872-AXZ-5551. Can ops coordinate?

aurora-supply: We're showing labels sent to procure@redwood on 2024-04-02. Re-sent now. AWB attached: `AWB: 872-AXZ-5551`

jon-procure: I have the label PDF but depot says serials mismatch on manifest vs RMA form. Sending manifest snippet.
```
Manifest serials: H100-1001,H100-1002,H100-1003,H100-1004,H100-1005,H100-1006,H100-1007,H100-1008
RMA form serials: H100-1001,H100-1002,H100-1004,H100-1005,H100-1006,H100-1007,H100-1008
```

lina-ops: Depot acceptance team: they need vendor-signed RMA + customs proforma with HS code listed. Also need return labels referencing original AWB or they reject for insurance.

maria-pm: @lina can you escalate to depot SLO? We're on a hot path — these GPUs backfill Dedicated pool in eu-west1.

de pot-bot: Depot update: Received attempt to check in 08:15 local. Hold status: `Pending - Labels`. ETA to clear once docs uploaded: 12-24h.

sam-ops: If we don't clear today, we'll miss the canary capacity target. Ask vendor to reissue labels with `RETURN-AWB:872-AXZ-5551` in GS1 field and include HS 8471.80. @aurora-supply pls confirm.

aurora-supply: Roger. We'll reissue with HS 8471.80 and vendor RMA# AUR-3321. New files uploaded to SFTP: `/outgoing/redwood/aurora_872_AXZ_5551_rma.zip`

jon-procure: FYI finance flagged potential import tax reclaim forms — need commercial invoice unredacted. I'll send to finance to clear.

lina-ops: Once labels are reissued, depot wants a 1-hour window to prepare dock teams. Sam, can you book slot? Prefer 15:00-16:00 CET

sam-ops: Booked slot 15:00-16:00 CET with depot. I'll paste gate pass when we have final docs. :thumbsup:

aurora-supply: Added `RETURN_LABEL_REF` to airway bill metadata. Confirmed SFTP upload complete.

de pot-bot: Gate pass created: `GATE-RED-0912` (pending final RMA doc).

maria-pm: Thanks — keep thread updated. If still blocked by 14:00 CET, we'll fallback to EU loaner pool and escalate to sales to notify customers.

sam-ops: Got it. Will update by 14:30 CET.
